entries.title: Statistical publications
entries.note: Use the latest dated release relevant to the claim; the portal is not itself evidence for a figure.

entries.title: 2025 Statistical Abstract
entries.note: Select the chapter and table whose period and definition match the plan claim.

entries.title: Statistical Abstract catalogue
entries.note: Use the latest published abstract and retain the table, period, and access date.

entries.title: Domestic tax guidance
entries.note: Verify the current Act, Finance Act, effective date, and taxpayer facts before using a rate or threshold.

entries.title: Business registration services
entries.note: Confirm entity-specific forms, fees, and filing steps at the time of use.

entries.title: Environmental regulations
entries.note: Screen the actual project and location; do not infer an approval requirement from sector alone.

entries.title: Standards and certification portal
entries.note: Identify the product-specific compulsory standard and current conformity route.

entries.title: Licensing and regulation portal
entries.note: Confirm whether the proposed service is regulated before modelling licence cost or lead time.

entries.title: Financial-sector supervision portal
entries.note: Regulatory perimeter and licensing status require competent legal and regulatory review.

entries.title: World Development Indicators
entries.note: Record indicator code, edition, country, year, and retrieval date; do not substitute regional data for national evidence.

entries.publisher: Parliament of Uganda (Act 9 of 2019, now Cap. 97); Minister of ICT (S.I. 21 of 2021)
entries.title: Data Protection and Privacy Act 2019 and Data Protection and Privacy Regulations 2021
entries.note: Kaizen currentness register PL-01 (2026-09-23): PDPO registration valid 12 months; consent required to collect; s.26 objection right with 14-day response. The PDPO site did not render, so current fees and exemption notices are not confirmed. No ePrivacy-style opt-in rule; do not claim one.

entries.publisher: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner
entries.title: Data Protection (General) Regulations 2021 and Registration Regulations 2021
entries.note: Kaizen currentness register PL-02 (2026-09-23). Later amendments were not checked; no ODPC direct-marketing guidance note was found.

entries.title: Digital 2026: Uganda
entries.note: Kaizen currentness register MK-02. Meta ad reach was measured while Facebook was blocked in Uganda; use it as a floor, never as the social-media population. Ad reach is not users. Replace when Digital 2027 is published.

entries.publisher: Parliament of Kenya; Cabinet Secretary ICT
entries.title: Data Protection Act 2019 s.37 and General Regulations 2021 reg.8, 14-17
claim_families: commercial use of personal data consent
entries.note: Kaizen currentness register 2026-09-24 KE-06. s.37 needs express consent or written-law authority with notice; reg.15 direct-marketing offence (fine up to KES 20,000 or 6 months). s.37(3) guidelines not found published.

entries.publisher: Media Council of Kenya (Legal Notice 88 of 2025)
entries.title: Code of Conduct for Media Practice 2025 cl.14
entries.note: Kaizen register KE-02 (KE-01 for the absence claim). Binds media practitioners; whether an influencer is one under the Media Council Act 2013 was not read. No dedicated Kenyan influencer statute found.

entries.title: Consumer Protection Act 2012 s.12 (false, misleading or deceptive representation)
entries.note: Kaizen register KE-03. Original 2012 text; no express endorsement clause. Competition Act (KE-04) and ASBK Code (KE-05) are secondary checks; Kenya Information and Communications Act and CA instruments were not read.

entries.title: Electronic and Postal Communications (Online Content) Regulations 2020, amended 2022 (GN 136)
entries.note: Kaizen register TZ-01. No sponsored-content disclosure clause. 2025 amendment (GN 57) reported only by a secondary source; whether influencers need a licence is unconfirmed.

entries.title: Fair Competition Act 2003 s.15-16 (misleading conduct, false sponsorship)
entries.note: Kaizen register TZ-02. Original text; check numbering against the consolidation (Cap. 285 R.E. 2023).

entries.title: Quality of Service report, August to September 2024
entries.note: Kaizen register NET-01. Operator mean download about 5-16 Mbps in 30 towns, taken from an Ecofin summary (2025-01-20); the UCC table is an image and was not verified. Town-based operator averages, not a user median. Ookla and Opensignal Uganda figures NOT_ASSESSED (NET-03).

entries.title: Kenya mobile median download snapshots, about October 2025
entries.note: Kaizen register NET-04. Roughly 45-50 Mbps median mobile in 2025 snapshots (secondary); the 28 ms latency baseline has no source and is dropped. Tanzania and Rwanda: no source found.

entries.title: WhatsApp and Facebook dominate the social media landscape in middle-income nations (2024-03-22)
entries.note: Kaizen register WA-02. Fieldwork Feb-May 2023, adults not smartphone users; median 73% across 8 countries, range 50% to 90%; Kenya below 90% (inference), exact value in an unread chart.

entries.title: 'WhatsApp used by 90%+ of smartphone users in East Africa' claim check
claim_families: WhatsApp share of smartphone or internet users
entries.note: Kaizen register WA-01: refuted as worded; the 90%+ figures trace to unattributed estimates on an internet-user base (WA-04, not citable). Country WhatsApp figures (Statista) are paywalled (WA-05, NOT_ASSESSED). Say dominant messaging channel; state source, base and date of any percentage.

entries.title: GSMA Intelligence terms of use (2025-02-19)
entries.note: Kaizen register LIC-09. Citations must be accurate and verbatim, not adapted, paraphrased or summarised. Free gsma.com Mobile Economy PDF terms not checked (404). Cite title, year, URL; do not paraphrase.
